scenarios.name: coldstart/45KB
scenarios.notes: Each repeat: a fresh client transport and, for the proxied arm, a freshly started proxy. first = the first request (new TCP connections on every hop); first_n = the first first_n; steady = after warm unrecorded requests. Repeat 0 also includes this process's first request through the proxy code.

scenarios.name: latency/45KB/mask-off
scenarios.notes: Non-streaming JSON against an instant mock upstream. No session header, but the proxy derives one from the body (passthrough.go:218-220), so within a repeat the requests form one session growing from 0; each repeat starts a fresh proxy.

scenarios.name: sse/45KB/events-300
scenarios.notes: Streaming. ttfb = first body byte; tail = the read completing message_stop to EOF, which includes the proxy's end-of-request bookkeeping. No session header, but the proxy derives one from the body (passthrough.go:218-220), so within a repeat the requests form one session growing from 0; each repeat starts a fresh proxy.

scenarios.name: concurrency/c1
scenarios.notes: Closed loop: c workers each send per_worker requests back to back. Arms alternate order by repeat (ABBA). rps = requests / wall time. No session header, but the proxy derives one from the body (passthrough.go:218-220), so within a repeat the requests form one session growing from 0; each repeat starts a fresh proxy.
